page_title: LIV 5-1 TOT | Liverpool v Tottenham Hotspur 27/04/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' That's it for today, Thomas Bramall has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+4' Harvey Elliott (Liverpool) is awarded a yellow card. The referee showed him no mercy.
90+4' Thomas Bramall has issued a yellow card to Richarlison (Tottenham).
90+3' Liverpool can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
90+2' Darwin Nunez (Liverpool) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence. The referee blows his whistle, Liverpool are awarded a corner kick.
90' 4 additional min. will be played.
90' Harvey Elliott (Liverpool) expertly controls the pass inside the penalty area and shoots, but it's inadvertently blocked a defender.
88' Rough tackle by Ibrahima Konate (Liverpool). The referee blows his whistle for a foul.
87' A quickly taken corner by Liverpool.

87' Diogo Jota (Liverpool) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked. Liverpool have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
86' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Mohamed Salah (Liverpool).
85' The ball is cleared after Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
83' Substitution. Alexis Mac Allister will be replaced by Darwin Nunez (Liverpool).
81' 61:39 – the latest ball possession ratio.
76' Arne Slot has decided to substitute Trent Alexander-Arnold and he is replaced by Wataru Endo (Liverpool).
76' The referee signals a substitution. Harvey Elliott (Liverpool) is brought on as a substitute for Luis Diaz.
73' Wilson Odobert (Tottenham) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball away to eliminate the danger.
71' Here comes the VAR verdict: Referee Thomas Bramall signals that there was no offside and the goal stands! The Liverpool players celebrate.
71' Wait! Referee Thomas Bramall has indicated he is going to review the Liverpool goal using VAR. It’s probably to see if there was an offside in the build-up.
69' 5 - 1 Own goal! Destiny Udogie (Tottenham) suffers a good deal of misfortune as he accidentally puts a pass from one of the attacking players into his own net. The score is 5:1.
68' Arne Slot decides to make a substitution. Dominik Szoboszlai will be replaced by Curtis Jones (Liverpool).
68' Cody Gakpo comes off the pitch to be replaced by Diogo Jota (Liverpool).
68' A substitution has been made. Mathys Tel goes off and Wilson Odobert (Tottenham) comes on.
67' Here is a change. Dominic Solanke is going off and Ange Postecoglou gives the last tactical orders to Richarlison (Tottenham).
67' Virgil van Dijk (Liverpool) picks up a pass and fires a powerful long-range shot which goes painfully close to the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Tottenham.

66' Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool) collects a great pass inside the box and misses a sitter. His shot was directed towards the left post, but the goalkeeper pulls off a marvellous diving save and denies him.

65' Pape Matar Sarr (Tottenham) receives a low pass just outside the box and drills a fine strike towards the middle of the goal. Alisson pulls off a reflexive save to block his effort. Nice goalkeeping skill, indeed.
63' 4 - 1 Goal - 4:1! Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) gets a shot away from the edge of the box and scores into the bottom right corner. Dominik Szoboszlai provided an assist for the goal.
61' Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
60' The current number of shots on goal is 4:2.
58' Andrew Robertson (Liverpool) takes the corner which is cleared by the opposition's defence.
57' Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) breaks into the penalty area but his shot is blocked. The ball is out of play. Liverpool will have a chance to score from a corner.
56' A pass into the penalty area from Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) is intercepted by the defence.
54' The corner from Alexis Mac Allister (Liverpool) is intercepted by Guglielmo Vicario.

54' That's unlucky! Alexis Mac Allister (Liverpool) beautifully controls a pass and from the edge of the box drills a shot in on goal, but it's inadvertently blocked by a defender and cleared. Good work from Liverpool as they win a corner.
53' Alexis Mac Allister (Liverpool) puts a dangerous cross into the box, but the corner is cleared by the first man.
53' A cross into the box from Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool) is cleared. The ball goes out of play and Liverpool have been awarded a corner kick.
53' Alexis Mac Allister (Liverpool) decides to speed play up with a short corner kick.
52' Alexis Mac Allister (Liverpool) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out. Corner kick. Liverpool will have an opportunity.
51' Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's not a big threat for the goalkeeper as his effort is blocked by a defender.
50' The linesman signals that Cody Gakpo (Liverpool) is offside and the referee confirms the decision.
48' Ben Davies (Tottenham) makes a strong challenge and Thomas Bramall blows for a foul.
47' Brennan Johnson (Tottenham) is caught offside!
46' Half-time substitution. James Maddison (Tottenham) will not participate anymore and Dejan Kulusevski is coming on.
46' The game is over for Archie Gray. Pape Matar Sarr (Tottenham) comes on for the second half.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+4' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45+4' Andrew Robertson (Liverpool) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
45+2' Alexis Mac Allister (Liverpool) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Thomas Bramall saw the whole situation.
45+2' Cody Gakpo (Liverpool) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Guglielmo Vicario intercepts the ball.
45' The fourth official shows 4 min. of added time.
45' Mathys Tel (Tottenham) is able to continue to play.
43' Looks like Mathys Tel (Tottenham) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.
43' Brennan Johnson (Tottenham) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
41' The flag is raised and Brennan Johnson (Tottenham) is offside again, not for the first time today.
41' James Maddison (Tottenham) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away.
40' Djed Spence (Tottenham) holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows for a foul after seeing the whole situation.
38' Luis Diaz (Liverpool) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
34' Yellow card! It's like Cody Gakpo (Liverpool) was asking for a caution with his behaviour. Thomas Bramall agrees and books him.
34' 3 - 1 Goal! Cody Gakpo (Liverpool) was in the right place at the right time to get to the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball low inside the left post. It's 3:1.
32' Alexis Mac Allister (Liverpool) will deliver the corner kick.

32' Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away. The ball goes behind for a corner. Liverpool will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.

31' Trent Alexander-Arnold (Liverpool) takes the free kick from mid-range, but he balloons his effort high over the bar. What a miskick! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Tottenham.
29' Djed Spence (Tottenham) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety.
29' The corner from James Maddison (Tottenham) is intercepted by the defence.

28' Dominic Solanke (Tottenham) leaps highest around the penalty spot to meet a cross from the free kick and produces a promising goal-bound header towards the roof of the net, but Alisson pulls off a fine save to deny him. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Tottenham will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
28' James Maddison (Tottenham) takes a direct free kick.
27' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Liverpool.

24' 2 - 1 Goal! Alexis Mac Allister (Liverpool) neatly controls a decent pass from Ryan Gravenberch. He looks up and smashes an unstoppable drive into the roof of the net from the edge of the box. 2:1.
20' A goal, which was scored by Cody Gakpo (Liverpool), was disallowed due to offside.

19' 1 - 1 No offside! Referee Thomas Bramall points to the centre spot to indicate that the goal stands after the VAR review. That prompts big celebrations from the Liverpool players. Goal! Dominik Szoboszlai produces a great pass that finds Luis Diaz (Liverpool) inside the penalty area, who takes advantage of the situation to rifle a shot into the bottom left corner. 1:1.
17' Wait! Referee Thomas Bramall immediately makes the VAR signal, most likely to see if there was an offside in the build-up play.
16' The assistant referee raises his flag and the referee blows his whistle. Luis Diaz (Liverpool) puts the ball into the net, but he is flagged for offside.
14' Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) clips a neat ball into the box in the direction of Luis Diaz, but he can't get on the end of the pass.

12' 0 - 1 It's in the back of the net! Dominic Solanke (Tottenham) gets on the scoresheet after converting a chance from the resulting corner kick. He finds himself some space inside the box and plants a perfect header inside the right post. 0:1.
11' The referee awards a corner and James Maddison (Tottenham) goes over to take it.

10' Great chance! Cody Gakpo (Liverpool) controls a rebound inside the box. He only has the keeper to beat, but his shot flies a whisker wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Tottenham.
10' Alexis Mac Allister (Liverpool) takes the corner, but the goalkeeper jumps and gathers the ball.

9' Alexis Mac Allister (Liverpool) connects with a cross and shoots to the left side of the goal, but he can't get the power to direct it past Guglielmo Vicario, who makes a good save. Liverpool have a corner.
9' Alexis Mac Allister (Liverpool) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders.
7' Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) tries to find Luis Diaz, but he puts too much power on the pass.
7' Mathys Tel (Tottenham) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
6' Luis Diaz (Liverpool) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance.
5' Brennan Johnson (Tottenham) is adjudged to have been offside when making his run.
5' Mathys Tel (Tottenham) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball.

3' Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) takes a shot after receiving a good pass, but his effort from the edge of the box goes just over the crossbar. The ball goes out of play and Tottenham will have a goal kick.
1' Mathys Tel (Tottenham) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
1' The match has just started.
Liverpool will kick the game off.
Today's referee will be Thomas Bramall.
